title: From qualitative smoothness to uniform estimates for fully nonlinear elliptic equations
summary: We establish a general mechanism that turns qualitative smoothness into uniform, quantitative regularity estimates for fully nonlinear elliptic equations. The central conclusion is that, for compact classes preserved by the natural rescalings of the equation, qualitative and quantitative regularity have the same critical threshold. At second order, mere twice differentiability throughout the corresponding centered hull already forces a uniform $C^{2,α}$-theory for some $α>0$.
